findings.body:
**Distinguish a test signature from its body.**

In `src/ops/gates/pythonSkipMarkers.ts:197`, `def test_x(dep=pytest.importorskip("optional")):` gets `inTestBody: true` because `trackDefs` already pushed `test_x`. However, Python evaluates the default when defining the function, outside its body. ([docs.python.org](https://docs.python.org/3.12/reference/compound_stmts.html))

The scanner therefore reports a dependency guard that its documented policy excludes. Track signature expressions separately from the function body. Preserve detection for calls in the actual body, including a same-line suite.
findings.title: Distinguish a test signature from its body.

findings.body:
**Preserve short-string state across escaped newlines.**

In `src/ops/gates/pythonSkipMarkers.ts:390`, an unmatched short quote leaves the state as `null`. Python permits this continued literal: ([docs.python.org](https://docs.python.org/3.12/reference/lexical_analysis.html))

```python
def test_x():
    text = "prefix \
suffix"; pytest.skip("reason")
```

The next line treats the literal's closing quote as an opening quote. It blanks the executable `pytest.skip(`, so the scanner misses the marker. Carry the quote state across an escaped newline and resume scanning after its actual closer.
findings.title: Preserve short-string state across escaped newlines.

findings.body:
**Recognize raised skip exceptions through imported aliases.**

After `from pytest import skip as s`, an added `raise s.Exception("reason")` has no matching rule. In `src/ops/gates/pythonSkipMarkers.ts:259`, the alias rule accepts only `s(...)`. The fallback requires the literal name `skip`.

`pytest.skip.Exception` is the skip exception, so the aliased form must retain that recognition. Add a raised-exception rule for aliases mapped to `pytest.skip`. ([docs.pytest.org](https://docs.pytest.org/en/8.4.x/reference/reference.html?utm_source=openai))
findings.title: Recognize raised skip exceptions through imported aliases.
